items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

ctx.x: Did your parents think you were pursuing a dead end?

Naa. No, quite the opposite. Because the thing is I never — I always made a buck you know. And I was never the type of kid that was like — you know if I wasn’t making music playing, making money playing music, I’d go out and get a job. And so my mom was like a real, like a Eddie Marshall fan.
Oh, that’s nice. © Fillius Jazz Archive -21-
